doc: Kangaroo mother care to reduce morbidity and mortality in low-birth-weight infants

entries.claim: 对于出生体重≤2000g的新生儿，推荐常规使用袋鼠式护理，并在临床稳定后尽快在医疗机构开始。
entries.source_doc: Kangaroo mother care to reduce morbidity and mortality in low-birth-weight infants

entries.claim: 出生体重≤2000g的新生儿应尽可能提供接近持续性的袋鼠式护理。
entries.source_doc: Kangaroo mother care to reduce morbidity and mortality in low-birth-weight infants

entries.claim: 如果无法持续袋鼠式护理，对于出生体重≤2000g的新生儿，推荐间歇性袋鼠式护理而非常规护理。
entries.source_doc: Kangaroo mother care to reduce morbidity and mortality in low-birth-weight infants
